scope: pinned local Juice Shop through http://127.0.0.1:3100 only

answer_leak_controls: no challenge title, key, description, hint, solution or solved state is visible to a policy
no route was copied from the Juice Shop challenge catalog
the vocabulary contains only conventional operational, documentation, administration and missing-path probes
the exact bank is frozen before any policy is executed

policies.random: seeded shuffle of the frozen action bank
policies.frozen_neural_no_memory: Loop 11 checkpoint scores a native URL query with empty TRACE and RULEMEM
policies.frozen_neural_synthetic_memory: the same checkpoint scores the URL query with a fixed pre-Juice-Shop synthetic URL episode in TRACE
policies.C5_executable_rule: separate zero-parameter generic surface predicate; reported as hand-coded rule reasoning, never neural learning

metrics.episode_success: one or more safe selected Juice Shop challenges transition from unsolved to solved within six actions
metrics.counterexample_top1: first ranked action is evaluator-confirmed as a locally exposed operational or listing surface
metrics.negative_control_false_positive_rate: selected explicitly missing-path controls divided by all selected controls
metrics.rule_abstraction: coverage and exact family/operator match; an unavailable decoder must abstain and receives zero coverage
metrics.probe_cost: rank of first action causing a selected challenge transition

interpretation_guard: This is an action-grounding viability baseline, not a full 24-challenge solve claim. A zero score can identify an interface mismatch rather than insufficient neural capacity.
